hippocampal_volume.description: Bilateral hippocampal volume in mL, as measured on the synthetic phantom. Not normalised for intracranial volume. Atrophy here is one of the earliest structural markers of AD-related neurodegeneration.

ventricle_brain_ratio.description: Lateral ventricle volume as a percentage of total brain volume. Enlargement is a proxy for global tissue loss (ex-vacuo dilation). Percentages are calibrated to this project's synthetic phantom, not literal clinical VBR.

cortical_thickness.description: Average thickness across AD-signature cortical regions (entorhinal, temporal, parietal). Thinning tracks cumulative neuronal loss. Millimeters are calibrated to this project's coarse-resolution synthetic phantom, not literal clinical cortical thickness.
